messages:
Priya Shah: Heads up — compiling field snippets from Helio onboarding call into a single bucket for product. Need quick prio on top-5 asks before EOD so we can feed into next sprint planning. Will paste raw notes below. Can folks add short impact estimates? @Diego @Sam @Maya

Diego Ramos: Got it. From today's Helio call — three asks: 1) per-route billing toggle, 2) faster embedding refresh, 3) UI to map routes->policies. Raw notes: ```- customer: Helio Health
- pain: can't split costs by route
- workaround: manual csv exports
- ask: per-route billing toggle + UI```

Sam Lin: Suggest we tag each ask with: impact: (low/med/high), users affected: (# of seats/accounts), renewal_risk: (none/medium/high). I can create a quick Google Sheet template. Link: https://tiny.redwood/helio-bucket. Also I'd vote per-route billing = high.

Maya Chen: Agree w/ Sam. Also need Product owner — who's owning the writeup? @Ava?

Ava Gomez: I'll take writeups. I'll convert Diego's raw notes into ticket template and add acceptance criteria. ETA 2pm. Quick Q — do we prefer 'feature-request' label or 'onboard-ask' in JIRA?

Priya Shah: :thumbsup: Use 'onboard-ask' for now, we'll re-label later. Also small ask — include any quant metrics (e.g., % of customers asking).

Sam Lin: I'll add estimated users and a short note about renewal risk from CS survey. Btw, should we include a short repro gif? customers sometimes send screenshots. Small policy: redact PII.

Maya Chen: Noted re: PII. For prioritization, propose simple scoring: impact_score = (impact_weight * users_affected) + renewal_penalty. We'll discuss in weekly sync.

cs-bot: Reminder: upload completed tickets to the 'CS Intake' board and tag @product-triage to ensure they get into the roadmap queue.

Priya Shah: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll close the bucket after Ava posts tickets and @Sam fills metrics. If anyone has other Helio snippets drop them here.
